title: packera dubia
intro: Packera dubia, commonly known as Golden Ragwort, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and supporting the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These constituents have been shown to have potential therapeutic applications, including anti-cancer and anti-arthritic effects.
